_doc: Facts about llm-d-router at the locked commit. Metric-name source only, like vllm: nothing is installed or launched; the lock exists so the EPP routing/scheduling names in assets/promql/starter.yaml and references/telemetry.md can't drift. The blis lock entry separately records the router version embedded in each BLIS binary (its `router` field). Re-verify every entry when the lock changes.
_doc_note: distinct from the per-binary `router` fields in the blis entry: those are the llm-d-router built into each blis apparatus binary (v1.0.0-blis.2 tag and the cc4cc8f6 fork); this entry is the standalone router repo the metric names were checked against

counters_declared_with_total.source: pkg/epp/metrics/llm_d_router_metrics.go:43 (request_total), :52 (request_error_total), :261 (scheduler_attempts_total); pkg/epp/framework/plugins/scheduling/profilehandler/disagg/metrics.go:60 (disagg_decision_total). client_golang does not append _total, so the exposed names are as-is

disagg_label.source: disagg/metrics.go LlmdDisaggDecisionCount labels: plugin_name, plugin_type, model_name, decision_type — there is no `decision` label, so the starter query aggregates by (decision_type)

decision_type_labels.source: disagg/metrics.go DecisionTypeDecodeOnly/PrefillDecode/EncodeDecode/EncodePrefillDecode constants (:32-38), chosen by DisaggDecisionType(encodeUsed, prefillUsed) in disagg_profile_handler.go:358,382

queue_size_custom_collector.value: llm_d_epp_per_endpoint_queue_size is a custom-collector Desc (labels name, model_server_endpoint) registered by NewInferencePoolMetricsCollector
queue_size_custom_collector.source: pkg/epp/metrics/llm_d_router_metrics.go; kept in the starter list as a direct-read gauge, not a rate()

plugin_duration_labels.source: pkg/epp/metrics/llm_d_router_metrics.go: llm_d_epp_plugin_duration_seconds labels; the starter query aggregates by (le, plugin_type)
